enumDescriptions: Attach for live counters when a .NET debug session starts
Suspend the process at launch and profile from the first instruction
dotnetProfiler.autoProfile.description: What to do when a .NET debug session starts.

dotnetProfiler.includeBlockedThreads.description: Include samples from threads that are blocked or in native code (wall-clock rather than CPU time).

dotnetProfiler.inlineAnnotations.description: After a recording, show each hot method's own/total time and allocations at the end of its declaration line.

dotnetProfiler.namespaceFilter.markdownDescription: Limit every profiler result - call stacks, top functions, allocations and heap snapshot types - to these namespaces. `Profiler.Host` covers that namespace and everything nested under it; `Profiler.Host.*` is the same written explicitly, and a `*` inside a pattern matches one name segment. Separate several patterns with `;`. Applies to the next recording or snapshot; leave empty to profile the whole process.

dotnetProfiler.openPanelOnAttach.description: Open the profiler panel automatically when a session attaches.

dotnetProfiler.processListRefreshMs.description: How often the .NET Processes list re-enumerates, in milliseconds. Only polls while the view is visible. Set to 0 to refresh only when you click the refresh button.

dotnetProfiler.refreshIntervalMs.description: How often live counters are sampled and the graphs update, in milliseconds. Lower values are more responsive but increase EventPipe traffic. Applies immediately to running sessions.

dotnetProfiler.trackAllocations.description: Collect allocation-by-type data during CPU profiling (raises the runtime provider to Verbose).
